pages.title: Volcanic hybrid
pages.text: A rare solitary reptile beside open Nether lava lakes. 100 HP, fire immunity, heavy bite and rear tail attack. Hybrid oil helps; dodge sideways after its windup.

pages.title: Molten Heart
pages.text: Reduce health to 25 HP. During its eight-second exhaustion, use a Molten Heart. A tamed basilisk recovers to 60 HP. An ordinary click cannot tame it.

pages.title: Controls and feeding
pages.text: Use empty-handed to ride; a saddle is optional. Sneak dismounts. Sneak+Use empty-handed: Follow → Stay → Wander. Owner only.

pages.title: Feeding
pages.text: Food in either hand takes priority over riding and commands. Raw meat heals 4 HP, cooked meat 6, blaze powder 8, blaze rod 12. Full health consumes nothing; creative feeding is free.

pages.title: Crossing lava
pages.text: The basilisk floats on lava and travels faster there than on land. Its passenger is protected from contact lava only while riding over lava; dismounting ends protection. Enemy attacks remain dangerous. Owner, saddle, health and mode persist.

pages.title: Loot
pages.text: Combine scales and slime for magma cream; a volcanic gland, coal and gunpowder yield fire charges. Also drops hybrid essence and a rare head trophy.
